source: PK COLUMN NAMES corrected 2026-07-16 from live PRAGMA table_info (pk>0) on the first sorted itsm seed; prior version had the placeholder string 'PRIMARY' for every table, which the labeler (labeler.py:217 `row[pk]`) cannot key on -> KeyError 'PRIMARY' blocked all itsm validation. FLAGGED for orchestrator review.
composite_pk_note: role_permission (role_id,perm_id) and user_role (user_id,role_id,org_id) have composite PKs; the labeler keys on a single column, so the first PK column is registered here. Both are static reference tables that no M4 itsm task mutates, so single-column keying cannot fabricate damage (initial and final collapse identically). Revisit if a future task writes these tables.
